# When to Visit China

> A data-backed travel planning guide helping travelers find the best time to visit China, combining 10-year climate data from the China Meteorological Administration, crowd intelligence, flight price tracking, and firsthand travel experience across 20+ Chinese cities.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/): Interactive guide covering best travel seasons, regional climate matrix, month timeline, crowd calendar, cost trends, and seasonal narratives, with a month/region comparison tool.
- [When to Go Quiz](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/when-to-go/): Eight-question interactive quiz that recommends ideal travel months based on preferences for region, budget, activity type, crowd tolerance, temperature, festivals, trip duration, and departure origin.
- [Monthly Guide](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/monthly-guide/): Complete month-by-month breakdown of weather (temperature range, rain days), crowd levels (1-5 scale), best regions per month, highlights, downsides, and packing recommendations for all 12 months.
- [By Region](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/by-region/): Regional travel timing guide covering 8 major Chinese regions: Beijing/North, Shanghai/East, Guilin/South, Chengdu/Sichuan, Yunnan, Tibet, Xi'an/Central, and Hong Kong.
- [Festivals Calendar](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/festivals/): Complete 2026 Chinese festival calendar with dates, durations, crowd levels, descriptions, and practical travel tips for 9 major festivals including Chinese New Year, Golden Week, Mid-Autumn, and Dragon Boat.
- [Crowd Calendar](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/crowd-calendar/): Interactive full-year crowd calendar for 2026, each day color-coded by crowd level with event notes for major Chinese holidays, covering China's top 20 attractions.
- [Travel Cost Guide](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/travel-cost/): Comprehensive cost breakdown including flight price trends by month, hotel price index by season, city-by-city cost comparison, three sample itineraries at budget/mid/luxury tiers, and 8 money-saving tips.
- [FAQ](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/faq/): Twelve frequently asked questions covering best months, cheapest times, worst periods, Golden Week crowds, October weather, Chinese New Year travel, rainy season timing, visa requirements, safety, and booking timelines.

## Month Guides

- [January](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/january/): Skiing, Harbin Ice Festival, lowest flight prices; bitterly cold in the north.
- [February](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/february/): Chinese New Year celebrations and lantern festivals; heavy travel disruption.
- [March](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/march/): Cherry blossoms, warming temperatures, shoulder-season deals.
- [April](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/april/): Perfect spring weather, Great Wall hiking season, peony blossoms in Luoyang.
- [May](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/may/): Warm pleasant weather everywhere; avoid Labor Day week crowds.
- [June](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/june/): Dragon Boat Festival, lush green scenery, long daylight hours.
- [July](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/july/): Best month for Tibet and Qinghai Lake; hot and humid elsewhere.
- [August](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/august/): Inner Mongolia grasslands and highland escapes; typhoon season on the coast.
- [September](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/september/): Mid-Autumn Festival, perfect hiking weather returns.
- [October](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/october/): Best weather of the year and peak autumn colors; avoid Golden Week Oct 1-7.
- [November](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/november/): Lowest crowds, crisp clear days, best value flights and hotels.
- [December](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/month/december/): Harbin ice festivals, Christmas markets in Shanghai, low-season prices.

## Region Guides

- [Beijing](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/region/beijing/): Imperial history and four distinct seasons; best in September-October and April-May.
- [Shanghai](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/region/shanghai/): Modern skyline and walkable riverfront; best in March-May and October-November.
- [Guilin](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/region/guilin/): Karst mountains and Li River scenery; best in April-October.
- [Chengdu](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/region/chengdu/): Giant pandas and Sichuan cuisine; best in March-June and September-November.
- [Yunnan](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/region/yunnan/): Lijiang, Dali and Shangri-La; mild year-round, best in March-May.
- [Tibet](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/region/tibet/): Lhasa and Everest Base Camp; accessible May-October only.
- [Xi'an](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/region/xian/): Terracotta Warriors and ancient city wall; best in March-May and September-November.
- [Hong Kong](https://www.best-time-to-visit-china.com/region/hongkong/): Victoria Harbour and dim sum; best in October-December.

## Data Sources

- [China Meteorological Administration](https://www.cma.gov.cn/en/): Climate data, 10-year averages 2016-2025.
- [Google Flights](https://www.google.com/travel/flights): Aggregated flight price data, updated quarterly.
- [Wikipedia: Golden Week (China)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Week_(China)): Holiday calendar and travel volume context.
- [Wikipedia: Harbin International Ice and Snow Sculpture Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harbin_International_Ice_and_Snow_Sculpture_Festival): Festival dates and scale.
- [Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the PRC](https://www.mct.gov.cn/): Tourism statistics and official holiday schedules.
